nodes.label: Case Study: Per-Sample SyncD Comparison
nodes.description: Case study figure comparing SyncD (lower is better) across TTS models (index tts2_baseline, gsv_tts, fish_audio, f5_tts_loudnorm, f5_tts) for samples 8, 1, and 6, with natural speech baseline (SyncD=8.189) as reference. Includes RMS energy envelope comparison between natural and f5_tts.

metadata.finding: TTS model lip-sync performance is highly sample-dependent; f5_tts often performs well but struggles on Sample 6

nodes.label: GSV-TTS
nodes.description: GSV-TTS model evaluated in case study. Shows poor SyncD performance on Sample 1 (red bar, high SyncD, poor sync).

metadata.finding: Performs poorly on Sample 1, variable across other samples

nodes.label: Index TTS2 Baseline
nodes.description: Index TTS2 baseline model evaluated in case study. Shows highest SyncD (worst sync) on Sample 8 and generally poor performance.
